## Reports

- [Integrate reports using Transaction Reports API](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/reports/api.md): The [Transaction Search API](https://developer.paypal.com/docs/api/transaction-search/v1/) provides programmatic access to your PayPal transaction data, enabling real-time queries…
- [Download reports from your dashboard](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/reports/dashboard-downloads.md): The PayPal dashboard provides a user-friendly way to generate and download reports without any coding requirements.
- [Report fields and formats reference](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/reports/fields-formats.md): The Activity Download Report provides you with access to transaction details for advanced reporting.
- [Get started with PayPal reports](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/reports/get-started.md): PayPal Reports provide detailed insights into your business transactions, helping you track performance, reconcile accounts, and analyze customer behavior patterns.
- [How reports and analytics work](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/reports/how-it-works.md): PayPal's reporting system processes transaction data in real-time and batch modes, providing comprehensive insights through various access methods and data formats.
- [Manage and automate reports](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/reports/manage-automate.md): PayPal offers several options to automate and schedule the generation and delivery of reports, helping you streamline reconciliation, compliance, and business intelligence…
